title: The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, July 27, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, July 27, 2018 Posted by admin on July 27th, (AAPL) down -4 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +112.97 (+0.44%) at 25,527.07.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.27%.
There were 20 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Travelers (TRV) +2.54% and Disney (DIS) +2.10%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by McDonald’s (MCD) -1.73% and Microsoft (MSFT) -1.09%.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
 two-tenths of a cent at $2.855 reported earnings on 7/26/2018 after the market close of $1.04, beating estimates of $1.00 per share.
Chevron (CVX) reported open of $1.78, missing estimates calling for $2.095 per share.
Exxon Mobil (XOM) reported open of $0.92, missing estimates calling for $1.249 per share.
Merck (MRK) reported open of $1.06, meeting expectations of $1.059 per share.
